import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the films table
films = pxt.get_table('films')

# Filter for years > 1990, select title and revenue columns, and materialize results
results = films.where(films['year'] > 1990).select(films['title'], films['revenue']).collect()

# Print the materialized rows
for row in results:
    print(row)
